notes: The entry is Infisical's own src/main.ts without telemetry, migrations, signal handlers and listen(): createApp() builds the Fastify app and returns its request listener.
The database is migrated and seeded before each run, as Infisical's e2e tests do (prepare.cjs, from the TypeScript sources under Infisical's own tsx); that is deployment, not adoption.

Queue workers stay on, as in Infisical's e2e tests: at this commit main() exits with QUEUE_WORKERS_ENABLED=false. The background work they start is what the twin's turns keep out of each request's comparison.
ghost-pino.mjs points pino at a worker-safe transport so a ghost (itself a worker thread) can start Infisical's logger.

The second, labeled run turns on opt-in Postgres real reads against a read-only role prepare.cjs creates (SELECT on all tables, nothing more); the twin also wraps every real read in a READ ONLY transaction, so a write is refused twice over.
